Kids Bible Class · September — Week 3

The Story of Joseph

Genesis 37; 39-47
Who is always with you?

“God is with you wherever you go.”

Joshua 1:9 (NLT)

God is always with me.

Image 1

Joseph's father loved him very much and gave him a beautiful colorful coat.

But Joseph's older brothers saw the coat and became very jealous of him.

Image 2

One day his brothers did something terrible.

They took his colorful coat and sold him to traders going far away to Egypt.

Joseph was taken from his family and his home.

Image 3

In Egypt, Joseph worked hard and did what was right.

But he was blamed for something he did not do, and he was thrown into prison.

Even there, God was with Joseph and helped him.

Image 4

Then Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, had two dreams that no one could understand.

God helped Joseph explain them: seven good years of food were coming, then seven hungry years.

Pharaoh was amazed and put Joseph in charge of storing up food for the whole land!

Image 5

When the hungry years came, Joseph's brothers traveled to Egypt looking for food —

and they found Joseph! Instead of paying them back, Joseph forgave them and hugged them.

God had been with Joseph the whole time. And God is always with me.

What We Learn

So many hard things happened to Joseph — his brothers sold him, he was a servant far from home, and he was even put in prison for something he didn't do. But God was with Joseph through every single part of it, and God used Joseph to save many people from hunger.

For you: Hard times don't mean God has left you. God was with Joseph in the pit, in the palace, and everywhere in between — and God is with you in your hard days too.
